title: Part IV · Section 02
subtitle: Participles / voice
introEn: Choose the best answer to complete the sentence or question.

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (a): Iam ______ your grade but you should still work
items.label: (a)
items.stem: Iam ______ your grade but you should still work

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (c): ______, he will become very famous.
items.label: (c)
items.stem: ______, he will become very famous.

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (b): Be careful not to ______ while you are working there.
items.label: (b)
items.stem: Be careful not to ______ while you are working there.

items.prompt: Words and Idioms Check-Up (d): ______ citizens rushed to the city hall.
items.label: (d)
items.stem: ______ citizens rushed to the city hall.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 1-(a): The man was ______ at the door, (stand )
accept: standing
items.label: 1-(a)
items.stem: The man was ______ at the door, (stand )

items.prompt: Warm-Up 1-(b): The dog got, ______ on the road, (kill)
accept: killed
items.label: 1-(b)
items.stem: The dog got, ______ on the road, (kill)

items.prompt: Warm-Up 1-(c): I found the vase ______. (break )
accept: broken
items.label: 1-(c)
items.stem: I found the vase ______. (break )

items.prompt: Warm-Up 1-(d): I was very ______ because the game was very
accept: excited
items.label: 1-(d)

items.prompt: Warm-Up 2-(a): Tom wrote the letter.
accept: The letter was written by Tom.
items.label: 2-(a)
items.stem: Tom wrote the letter.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 2-(b): The man will save the bird.
accept: The bird will be saved by the man.
items.label: 2-(b)
items.stem: The man will save the bird.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 2-(c): He has read the book several times.
accept: The book has been read several times by him.
items.label: 2-(c)
items.stem: He has read the book several times.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 2-(d): The woman is serving the people.
accept: The people are being served by the woman.
items.label: 2-(d)
items.stem: The woman is serving the people.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 3-(a): English is spoken by my friends in class.
accept: My friends speak English in class.
items.label: 3-(a)
items.stem: English is spoken by my friends in class.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 3-(b): She has been supported by him.
accept: He has supported her.
items.label: 3-(b)
items.stem: She has been supported by him.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 3-(c): The result was announced by him.
accept: He announced the result.
items.label: 3-(c)
items.stem: The result was announced by him.

items.prompt: Warm-Up 3-(d): Iam called Mr. Kim by them.
accept: They called me Mr. Kim.
items.label: 3-(d)
items.stem: Iam called Mr. Kim by them.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 1: Choose the set of participles that fits blanks (a)-(d).
Grammar Practice 2: Choose the awkward sentence.

choices.A: I was very tired when you called me last night.
choices.C: Why don't we do something exciting?
choices.D: I am boring. I want to play computer games.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 2-fix: Correct the wrong word in the awkward sentence.
accept: bored

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 3-(a): When I walked on the street, I encountered him.
accept: When walking on the street, I encountered him.
items.label: 3-(a)
items.stem: When I walked on the street, I encountered him.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 3-(b): Though I feel sleepy, I must not goto bed.
accept: Though feeling sleepy, I must not go to bed.
items.label: 3-(b)
items.stem: Though I feel sleepy, I must not goto bed.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 3-(c): As she does the dishes, she sings pop songs.
accept: Doing the dishes, she sings pop songs.
items.label: 3-(c)
items.stem: As she does the dishes, she sings pop songs.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 3-(d): As it was made in Japan, it is expensive.
accept: Made in Japan, it is expensive.
items.label: 3-(d)
items.stem: As it was made in Japan, it is expensive.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 4-(a): My boss made me clean his office.
accept: I was made to clean his office by my boss.
items.label: 4-(a)
items.stem: My boss made me clean his office.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 4-(b): Change the sentence into the passive voice — He took care of the wounded bird.
accept: The wounded bird was taken care of by him.
items.label: 4-(b)
items.stem: He took care of the wounded bird.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 4-(c): She caught sight of the sunrise.
accept: The sunrise was caught sight of by her.
items.label: 4-(c)
items.stem: She caught sight of the sunrise.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 4-(d): I saw my grandfather playing basketball at dawn.
accept: My grandfather was seen to play
items.label: 4-(d)
items.stem: I saw my grandfather playing basketball at dawn.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 5-(a): I turned off the radio.
accept: The radio was turned off by me.
items.label: 5-(a)
items.stem: I turned off the radio.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 5-(b): Who made it?
accept: By whom was it made?
items.label: 5-(b)
items.stem: Who made it?

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 5-(c): The man is repairing the chairs.
accept: The chairs are being repaired by the man.
items.label: 5-(c)
items.stem: The man is repairing the chairs.

items.prompt: Grammar Practice 5-(d): She made him pick it
accept: He was made to pick it up.
items.label: 5-(d)
items.stem: She made him pick it
